clues: This port town sits on a peninsula in northern Chile. The wide Pacific Ocean lies just west of it.
Just east of town starts the driest desert in the whole world. The town sits between that dry land and the sea.
Ships fought a key naval fight just west of town in 1879. The clash was part of the War of the Pacific.
This town marks the widest point in the whole country. East to west, the land spans wider here than anywhere else.
Punta Angamos stands on the north part of the peninsula. It marks the site of a famed sea battle.
